items.title: Variables and Data Types
items.content:
# Variables and Data Types

JavaScript variables are containers for storing data values.

## Declaring Variables

```javascript
const name = 'Alice';    // Cannot be reassigned
let age = 25;            // Can be reassigned
```

## Data Types

JavaScript has several primitive data types:

| Type | Example | Description |
|------|---------|-------------|
| String | `'hello'` | Text values |
| Number | `42` | Numeric values |
| Boolean | `true` | True or false |
| Null | `null` | Intentional empty value |
| Undefined | `undefined` | Unassigned variable |

## Type Checking

Use `typeof` to check a value's type:

```javascript
typeof 'hello'  // 'string'
typeof 42       // 'number'
typeof true     // 'boolean'
```

> **Tip:** Always use `const` by default, and only use `let` when you need to reassign a variable.
